representation.name: CD14 gene length mean expression Pearson v3
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
cat > job.R <<'RS'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
counts_path <- args[[1]]
meta_path <- args[[2]]
sample_path <- args[[3]]
answer_path <- args[[4]]
details_path <- args[[5]]

samples <- read.csv(sample_path, stringsAsFactors=FALSE, check.names=FALSE)
cd14_samples <- samples$sample[samples$celltype == 'CD14']
if (length(cd14_samples) == 0) stop('No CD14 samples found')

meta <- read.csv(meta_path, stringsAsFactors=FALSE, check.names=FALSE)
counts <- read.csv(counts_path, stringsAsFactors=FALSE, check.names=FALSE)

gene_col <- counts[[1]]
cd14_cols <- match(cd14_samples, names(counts))
if (any(is.na(cd14_cols))) {
  missing <- cd14_samples[is.na(cd14_cols)]
  stop(paste('Missing CD14 samples in count matrix:', paste(head(missing, 20), collapse=',')))
}

keep_meta_cols <- c('Geneid', 'Length', 'gene_biotype')
if (!all(keep_meta_cols %in% names(meta))) stop('Required metadata columns missing')
meta_small <- meta[, keep_meta_cols]
idx <- match(gene_col, meta_small$Geneid)
matched <- !is.na(idx)

length_vec <- as.numeric(meta_small$Length[idx])
biotype_vec <- meta_small$gene_biotype[idx]
expr_mat <- as.matrix(counts[, cd14_cols])
storage.mode(expr_mat) <- 'numeric'
totals <- rowSums(expr_mat)
means <- totals / length(cd14_cols)

protein <- matched & biotype_vec == 'protein_coding' & !is.na(length_vec)
expressed <- protein & totals >= 10
if (sum(expressed) < 3) stop('Fewer than three expressed protein-coding genes after filtering')

r <- cor(length_vec[expressed], means[expressed], method='pearson')
writeLines(format(r, digits=17, scientific=TRUE), answer_path)
details <- data.frame(metric=c('cd14_samples','count_matrix_cd14_columns','metadata_genes','matched_count_rows','protein_coding_matched_rows','expressed_protein_coding_rows_total_counts_ge_10','pearson_r'), value=c(length(cd14_samples), length(cd14_cols), nrow(meta_small), sum(matched), sum(protein), sum(expressed), format(r, digits=17, scientific=TRUE)))
write.table(details, details_path, sep='\t', row.names=FALSE, quote=FALSE)
RS
Rscript job.R "$(inputs.counts.path)" "$(inputs.meta.path)" "$(inputs.samples.path)" answer.txt details.tsv
